name: LS-reach-gate-dropped
note: A body across the room joins the pile, and a turn to it earns 'You are too far away'.

name: LS-members-out-of-order
note: The pile's front is no longer the nearest body.

name: LS-no-body-list-clears
note: The pile-of-drops pick a host casts in the same frame forgets the body the player turned to.

name: LS-stale-choice-kept
note: Looking away keeps a choice about a pile the player has left.

name: LS-vanished-body-chosen
note: A body emptied and disabled stays the choice.

name: LS-chosen-at-own-distance
old: return { key: stack[at].key, distance: first.distance, reach: stack[at].reach };
new: return { key: stack[at].key, distance: stack[at].distance, reach: stack[at].reach };
note: A dropped pile lying between two bodies steals the click the player turned to the second one for.

name: LS-turn-when-pile-lost
old: if (at < 0) return null;   // the pile did not win: a door, a person or a foe stands in front of it
note: A turn with a door in front of the pile turns the pile behind the door.

name: LS-no-wrap
note: The back of the pile never turns to its front.

name: LS-turn-kept
note: A turn is spent twice - and a turn armed at a door lands later on a pile.

name: LS-drop-noop
note: A turn armed before a window lands after it.

name: LS-turn-text-off-by-one
note: 'Body 0 of 3.'

name: LS-pick-bypasses-stack
old: return chooseBody(nearestActivatableHit(eye, dir, targets, collider), targets, (rest) => nearestActivatableHit(eye, dir, rest, collider));
note: The key turns nothing any reader of the ray hears.

name: LS-walk-ignores-the-world
note: A body behind a wall joins the pile.

name: LS-mark-gone
note: Nothing tells the player the body under the reticle is one of three.

name: LS-key-named-from-a-literal
note: A player who rebound the key is told to press the old one.

name: LS-unbound-key-named
note: An action bound to nothing reads 'null for the next'.

name: LS-no-repick-after-turn
note: On the turn's own frame the plaque names the body the press will no longer open.

name: LS-turn-landing-under-a-window
old: if (cursorActive || !eye || !dir || !collider) { dropBodyTurns(); foldQuickLoot(null); if (on) showWorldPlaque(null); return null; }
new: if (cursorActive || !eye || !dir || !collider) { foldQuickLoot(null); if (on) showWorldPlaque(null); return null; }
note: A turn pressed as a window opened lands on whatever the reticle meets when it closes.

name: LS-classic-cannot-turn
note: The classic skin's key does nothing.

name: LS-classic-picks-every-frame
note: The classic frame casts the reticle's ray every frame for a plaque it never draws.

name: LS-teardown-keeps-the-choice
note: A choice made in a dungeon points the street's press at a body that is not there.

name: LS-surface-bodies-unmarked
note: Every body above ground is one body again - the key turns nothing in the street or indoors.

name: LS-dungeon-bodies-unmarked
note: The key turns nothing underground.

name: LS-default-on-a-spent-key
note: One press turns the pile and drops the torch (Handheld Torches' G).

name: LS-row-missing-from-the-pane
old: Object.freeze({ action: 'NextBody', label: 'Next body in a pile' }),
note: The key cannot be rebound on the enhanced skin.

name: LS-world-turn-fires-the-activate
note: The pile's key activates whatever is under the reticle - a live foe in Steal mode is pickpocketed.

name: LS-exterior-turn-fires-the-activate
note: The same, in the standalone exterior host.

name: LS-dungeon-turn-fires-the-activate
note: The same, in the standalone dungeon host.

name: LS-divider-back-at-the-title
note: A chest's lock level and a pile's mark draw as the first row of the list.

name: LS-band-margin-a-literal
note: On the narrow sheet the band runs 2px into the border.

name: LS-band-left-padding-12
note: The lit name stands 2px left of every other name - the band moves a name.

name: LS-narrow-padding-a-literal
note: The narrow sheet pads 12 while the band still reaches out 14.

name: LS-clip-across-again
old: overflow: hidden; overflow-x: visible; overflow-y: clip; }
note: The list cuts the highlight band off at its edges, and the lit name's first letter with it.
